configure: open the Opovi plugin's settings, which is the plugin page's Settings tab in the desktop app and `echo '{"token":"<new token>"}' | claude plugin configure opovi@opovi --values-stdin` in a terminal (the other setting is `server_url`), save the value and start Claude Code again
update: run `claude plugin marketplace update opovi`, then `claude plugin update opovi@opovi`, and start Claude Code again
